findings.title: Backtest uses synthetic intraday data
findings.detail: The current 15-minute result describes Brownian Bridge disaggregation or synthetic bars.
findings.action: Do not use these metrics for live trading; rerun on real intraday bars.

findings.title: Model feature schema matches
findings.detail: Both artifacts list 28 features in the same order.
findings.action: Keep feature order immutable between training and inference.

findings.title: Scored universe matches training metadata
findings.detail: All 20 scored symbols appear in the model spec.
findings.action: Keep this check in the inference pipeline.

findings.title: Average HOLD probability is near zero
findings.detail: Average HOLD probability is 0.000074, which suggests calibration or label-distribution issues.
findings.action: Review labels, class weights, probability calibration, and no-trade thresholds.

findings.title: Most symbols fail production gates
findings.action: Paper trade only passing symbols after real-data validation; reject failed symbols.
